description: The bar chart illustrates the number of hateful communication datasets published annually from 2012 to 2022, categorized by the location of the researchers who created them, as presented in the paper “The Unseen Targets of Hate — A Systematic Review of Hateful Communication Datasets.” The vertical axis, labeled “Number of datasets,” is plotted on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10⁰ (1) to 10² (100), with major gridlines at 1, 10, and 100. The horizontal axis represents the year, spanning 2012 to 2022. Each year features a grouped set of colored bars corresponding to researcher locations: blue for “Other,” red for “UK,” orange for “USA,” purple for “IT” (Italy), green for “IN” (India), and brown for “DE” (Germany). The chart shows a general upward trend in dataset production over time, with a notable surge beginning around 2017 and peaking in 2021. In 2021, the “Other” category reaches the highest value, exceeding 100 datasets, followed by “USA” and “IN” both near 50, while “UK,” “IT,” and “DE” are lower but still substantial. In earlier years (2012–2015), only a few datasets are recorded, mostly from “USA” and “Other.” The bars are not sorted by height within each year, and no individual bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding. The legend is positioned in the upper left corner, clearly mapping colors to researcher locations.
